title: Concept: Swift package fetched over cleartext
description: Package.swift declares a package URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The checkout crosses the network unencrypted, so the source that compiles can be replaced in flight.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Package.swift (swift).
risk: The checkout crosses the network unencrypted, so the source that compiles can be replaced in flight.
